prompt: A 3 versus 3 soccer match on a rooftop at sunset

intent.setting: A walled, symmetric rooftop arena at sunset, with two team bases, hoops or gates, raised side decks and scattered cover blocks for play.
intent.role: A player on one of two rival teams in a 3v3 rooftop soccer match.
intent.goal: Score more goals than the rival team before the match timer expires.
intent.fail: Losing the match (opposing team has more goals at the end).
intent.mood: Competitive, warm and lively against a glowing sunset sky.
intent.headline: 3v3 rooftop soccer at sunset with walled symmetric arena
